title: Book Two · Chapter 121: The Wrong Leaf
story:
Miss Wu gives the reading group a new page on Monday. There are two tree pictures on it. Each has a short note below.

Ronan thinks of Jun's book. He keeps his eyes on his own sheet.

“Find a leaf for the small tree,” Miss Wu says. “Use the words as well as the pictures.”

The first note says the leaf is long and narrow. The second says it has five points. In the pictures both leaves look almost the same size.

Ronan chooses the pointed leaf. Then he reads the small tree's name again. The name is beside the first note.

He puts his pencil down.

“I need to compare these,” he says to himself.

Leo is across the table. “Compare what?”

“The notes and the names. The pictures are not enough.”

Leo moves his sheet aside. Ronan can no longer see Leo's answers.

“Then do yours first. I want to try alone.”

Ronan nods. He puts one finger on the name and one on the note. He follows the words slowly. Long and narrow. He draws a short line from the small tree to the correct leaf.

Miss Wu comes to his chair.

“Show me the words you used.”

He shows her the name first, then the shape words.

“Why not the other picture?”

“It has five points. That note belongs to the other tree.”

She asks him to write the explanation beneath the pictures. He writes three short sentences. His last sentence goes very close to the bottom edge.

Leo finishes a moment later. His line reaches the same leaf, but his explanation uses different words.

“May I look now?” Ronan asks.

“Yes.”

They compare the answers. Leo needs to add the word narrow. Ronan gave an answer aloud about the five points. He needs to write that down too. They each add a clear detail.

Miss Wu writes SHARED CHECK below their answers. She keeps their first answers and their later changes. Now she can see each pupil's work and the help from his friend.

At break, Ronan sees Jun carrying the tree book toward another pupil. He wants to mention his correct leaf answer. He nearly follows them.

Then the cloth ball lands near his shoe. Mei stands by the open space.

“Throw it here,” she calls.

Ronan sends it back. It flies too far. Mei runs three steps and catches it against her shoulder.

“Your leaf is not the only thing with points,” Leo says. “That throw needs a map.”

Ronan picks up the ball on the next turn. He aims lower. This time it reaches Mei's hands. She throws it back, and Ronan runs to catch it.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

compare＝比较；narrow＝窄的；point＝尖角；separate＝分开的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样找到正确的树叶？
2. 老师怎样区分独立作答与后来互查？

## 读句子

**He / puts / his pencil down.** 他／放下／铅笔。
